codebase-memory.description: Deterministic code knowledge-graph over the SEOSONA OS repo (chosen code-nav MCP). Tools: search_graph, query_graph, trace_call_path, get_architecture, get_code_snippet, detect_changes (blast-radius), get_graph_schema, search_code, list_projects, index_status, manage_adr, ingest_traces. Project name: D-SEOSONA-AI-SEOSONA-OS. Re-index after big changes: npm run codegraph:index

seosona-knowledge.description: Hybrid BM25 + TF-IDF search over the SEOSONA knowledge base (3_MEMORY/knowledge_items, incl. all UAP-harvested KIs). Tool: knowledge_search(query, limit) -> {backend, results:[{title, portablePath, score}], warning?}. The index rebuilds itself when the corpus changes; a degraded backend is reported as backend=lexical_degraded with a warning rather than silently returning nothing. Requires: pip install -r requirements.txt
